posting.title: Automotive Technician - Race Mechanic
posting.description:
Automotive Technician - Race Support Mechanic

Part-Time or Full-Time
Compensation: $30-$45 per hour, depending on experience
Location: Mid-Willamette Valley

Join a privately owned, fully equipped shop serving both a commercial fleet and an active off-road/drag racing program. We're looking for a dependable, detail-oriented technician who enjoys a wide variety of mechanical work in a professional, low-pressure environment. Unlike traditional repair shops, there are no flat-rate hours or customer billing responsibilities.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Service and maintain Ford E250/E350 vans and 2004-2016 Ford F-150 pickups
  • Prepare Broncos, Jeeps, UTVs, and competition UTVs for off-road racing
  • Assist with drag boat maintenance, race preparation, and trackside support for ADBA and CDBA events
  • Remove and install engines, transmissions, and drivetrain components
  • Perform routine diagnostics, repairs, and preventive maintenance
